acceptanceMapping.criterion: 1. New file smoke/stage3-proof.txt with a single marker line visible in the PR diff.
acceptanceMapping.surface: GitHub pull request diff on sjawhar/legion-smoke

acceptanceMapping.criterion: 2. PR passes the repository smoke check and merges to main.
acceptanceMapping.skill: legion-worker (tester verifies checks green; human merges)
acceptanceMapping.surface: GitHub Actions checks on the PR head: workflow 'ci' job 'check' and workflow 'fail-on-demand' job 'gate' (.github/workflows/ci.yml, fail-on-demand.yml)

acceptanceMapping.criterion: 3. If review asks for one appended line, implementer appends it in the same PR; in scope, no new spec version.
acceptanceMapping.surface: GitHub pull request diff after the corrective push

filesToChange: smoke/stage3-proof.txt (new; one line of marker text)
ordering: Single implementation commit creates the file; verification is the PR diff plus the two CI jobs green; no dependency ordering since exactly one file changes.

implement: none: reviewed the system <skills> list (all entries are legion-* phase/coordination skills) and the repo has no AGENTS.md or build/test tooling; the change only creates one marker file smoke/stage3-proof.txt, so only the legion-worker implementer flow applies and no domain implementation skill fits.
review: none: review is inspecting a one-line marker-file diff on the PR; no domain review skill applies beyond the legion-worker reviewer flow (thermonuclear passes run per that skill on non-docs PRs).
test: none: the repository has no test suite; the smoke check is the .github/workflows/ci.yml 'check' job and .github/workflows/fail-on-demand.yml 'gate' job, verified on the PR via 'legion gh -- pr checks'; no domain test skill exists in the <skills> list beyond the legion-worker tester flow.

summary: One-file smoke change: create smoke/stage3-proof.txt containing a single marker line, delivered through one PR that flows the full Legion phase pipeline (implement, test, review, merge). No code paths change.
tasks: Create smoke/stage3-proof.txt with exactly one line of marker text (e.g. 'Legion Stage 3 proof: S390383979-1.').
Commit onto the issue branch legion/S390383979-1, set the bookmark, push, and open the PR with body line 'Dispatch: S390383979-1'.
If the review requests one appended line, append exactly one more line to the same file in the same PR (in scope, no new spec version).

verification.implementer: Open the PR; confirm smoke/stage3-proof.txt appears in the diff with one line; confirm 'ci/check' and 'fail-on-demand/gate' are success at the head SHA. Negative control: a PR head carrying a .fail-me file makes 'fail-on-demand/gate' fail, proving the gate is live.
verification.tester: Independently re-run legion gh -- pr checks and legion gh -- pr diff at the head SHA; confirm the file and both jobs green.
